hero.positioning: platform engineering · cloud infrastructure · distributed systems
hero.description: I design and rebuild the complex, distributed systems software teams depend on: developer platforms, CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, and data systems. I build them to operate globally and evolve as scale, teams, and requirements change, without turning every new phase into a rewrite.
hero.background: Over the years I've worked across multiple startups and established companies in different industries, business models, and stages of growth. Each brought its own market pressures, operating dynamics, and technical constraints, placing me where software, infrastructure, and organizational complexity meet.
